Chapter 819: Chapter 21: Breakthrough! The Sixth Realm Of Space-Time (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 819: Chapter 21: Breakthrough! The Sixth Realm of Space-Time (Please Subscribe)

The Child of the Void’s look of astonishment was not concealed and similarly caught the eyes of the Eastern Wing Lord and the other Divine Masters.

“Great Child of the Void, what happened to Tianzhi? How is he?”

The Eastern Wing Lord inquired cautiously.

“Tianzhi has fallen into slumber, even his life-preserving incarnation is asleep.”

With a thought from the Child of the Void, Tianzhi True Lord’s life-preserving incarnation was transferred from the deepest area of the Void Secret Realm right before the eyes of the numerous Demonic Divine Masters.

“Asleep?”

...

The Eastern Wing Lord could not comprehend.

Tianzhi True Lord himself had strategically plotted every move to encircle and kill the Taiyin Sovereign, and just when he was about to take action, he fell into slumber?

If this wasn’t coming from the mouth of the Child of the Void, the Eastern Wing Lord would never believe it.

It was too absurd.

“He didn’t fall into slumber on his own, he was forced into slumber.”

The Child of the Void closely observed Tianzhi True Lord’s life-preserving incarnation and said.

“Slumber involuntarily?”

Eastern Wing Lord and Lord Divine Eye, as well as the other Demonic Divine Masters, exchanged glances, feeling a chill in their hearts.

Tianzhi True Lord is a Perfect Demon True Lord. In the vast Boundless Void, who could put Tianzhi True Lord into an unresisting slumber? To the point where not even a message could get out?

“How interesting, how interesting.”

“I didn’t expect something so interesting to happen in less than ten billion years of slumber.”

The Child of the Void murmured to himself. Although Tianzhi True Lord was not good at direct confrontation, making him fall into slumber quietly was something that even the Child of the Void needed to borrow some power from the Void Secret Realm to achieve.

“I’ll awaken Tianzhi and ask him, then I’ll know what’s going on.”

The consciousness of the Child of the Void began to seep into the body of Tianzhi True Lord’s life-preserving incarnation.

Tianzhi True Lord was forced into slumber and could not wake up by his own power.

But it was possible to awaken him through external stimulation, and of course, only the Child of the Void, who mastered the entire Void Secret Realm, could do this.

…

Tianqing World.

Deep within the Martial Hall.

Fifty years of arduous cultivation and enlightenment.

Lin Yuan was now infinitely close to the Space-Time Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm.

The ‘Milky Way’ of space-time was rippling over Lin Yuan’s body, like a miniature River of Space-Time.

[Your exceptional understanding has deepened your comprehension of the Secret Skill “Milky Way” and the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule…]

…

[Your exceptional understanding has deepened your comprehension of the Secret Skill “Milky Way” and the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule…]

…

[Your exceptional understanding has deepened your comprehension of the Secret Skill “Milky Way” and the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule…]

…

In a trance.

Lin Yuan felt the world before his eyes change.

The vast Boundless Void suddenly became extremely simple, consisting only of time and space.

“So that’s how it is.”

Lin Yuan’s mind surged with a tremendous amount of enlightening insights, almost breaking into the domain of the Space-Time Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm.

And at this moment.

Inside his world.

Tianzhi True Lord, who had been immersed in the grand ‘illusion’ woven by Lin Yuan, suddenly opened his eyes.

“Am I awake?”

“Have I escaped the illusion?”

Before Tianzhi True Lord had time to look around, his physical body and soul rapidly disintegrated.

“Noisy.”

Lin Yuan merely glanced at the spot where Tianzhi True Lord was within his inner world and continued his enlightenment.

As he was at a critical time transitioning into the Space-Time Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm, Lin Yuan naturally did not allow any instability to arise within his inner world.

Since Tianzhi True Lord had woken up at this time, regardless of what power he was relying on, direct eradication was the option.

“Space-Time…”

“How beautiful…”

Lin Yuan immersed his whole heart and soul into the comprehension of the essence of space-time.

…

Deep within the Void Secret Realm.

Under the gaze of the towering figure of the Child of the Void and the Eastern Wing Lord, as well as the other Demonic Divine Masters.

Tianzhi True Lord suddenly opened his eyes, not yet reacting before his expression dramatically changed.

Because he felt his true body had perished.

“Child of the Void…”

Seeing the towering figure looming over him, Tianzhi True Lord immediately said respectfully.

“Tell me, what exactly happened.”

The Child of the Void asked directly, his interest in Tianzhi True Lord’s predicament growing.

Over the long years, as the master of the Void Secret Realm, he had never felt any unexpected presence; everything was under control.

Yet now, from Tianzhi True Lord’s behavior, the Child of the Void felt a ‘curiosity’ that had disappeared for who knows how long.

“Yes.”

Tianzhi True Lord dared not defy the Child of the Void. In fact, he had no intention to conceal the truth and immediately revealed everything he knew.

“The Taiyin Sovereign is not the mastermind behind the scenes; the spread of Martial Tao is driven by the Martial Ancestor. The Taiyin Sovereign is just the one pushed to the front by the Martial Ancestor?”

Without any reply from the Child of the Void, the Eastern Wing Lord and the other Demonic Divine Masters nearby were stunned first.

For them, the Taiyin Sovereign was already strong enough, but behind him stood the Martial Ancestor whose strength was even greater than the Taiyin Sovereign’s. Even Tianzhi True Lord stood no chance against that Martial Ancestor?

“Indeed.”

“I incarnated into the Tianqing World and after a brief investigation, I learned that in that world, the heavens, the earth, and the spirits all worship the Martial Ancestor; they all revere the Martial Tao.”

The Tianzhi True Lord nodded; if he hadn’t seen it with his own eyes, he wouldn’t have believed any of this.

“The great Child of the Void, that Martial Ancestor is unbelievably powerful; it is estimated that he is infinitely close to the Tenth Stage. Apart from you, Child of the Void, there is no other Evil God in the Boundless Void who could resist him.”

The Tianzhi True Lord said respectfully to the towering figure.

Even in the face of the Martial Ancestor, his own true body could not manage to flee, being directly suppressed, forced into slumber, leading the Tianzhi True Lord to develop an inexplicable fear of the Martial Ancestor.

“Infinitely close to the Tenth Stage?”

The Child of the Void’s expression remained calm. To him, as long as it wasn’t a Tenth Stage Evil God, there was nothing to fear. With the Void Secret Realm under his control, he could sweep away all before him.

“Since that is the case, I shall go and see this Martial Ancestor for myself.”

The Child of the Void spoke immediately.

“Yes.”

The Tianzhi True Lord felt a slight relief within his heart.

As long as the great Child of the Void took action, no matter how powerful that Martial Ancestor was, the outcome was already determined.

…

The Boundless Void.

In front of a large world.

The forms of the Child of the Void and many other Perfect Demon True Lords appeared.

“Child of the Void, this world is one of the many worlds occupied by the Taiyin Sovereign. The Tianqing World, where the Martial Ancestor presides, lies in that direction.”

The Tianzhi True Lord immediately spoke.

His memory of the Tianqing World was indelibly deep; there was no chance of error.

“I understand.”

The Child of the Void’s presence was like an ocean, as he nodded slightly, “In that case, we will start with this world.”

Although the Child of the Void was very confident that no matter how powerful that Martial Ancestor was, he would not be his opponent,

the description of the Martial Ancestor by the Tianzhi True Lord still made the Child of the Void refrain from underestimating him.

Now that the Child of the Void had just awakened, the vast majority of his power was still slumbering, not yet fully revived.

Thus, he planned to eliminate the worlds occupied by the Martial Tao one by one on his way to the Tianqing World, taking the opportunity to end his dormant state and suppress the Martial Ancestor with his full glory.

“You go and draw out the Taiyin Sovereign first.”

The Child of the Void commanded, beyond wanting to meet the Martial Ancestor, he also wanted to have a look at this Taiyin Sovereign.

Since the Taiyin Sovereign was a powerful figure brought into the light by the Martial Ancestor, he must be able to reveal some of the Martial Ancestor’s techniques.

“Understood.”

Lord Divine Eye nodded and immediately manifested himself, arriving outside that large world.

“Taiyin Sovereign, come out – come out – come out –”

Lord Divine Eye’s voice traveled along space and time, and at that moment, all beings within the large world heard these words.

“Taiyin Sovereign, come out – come out – come out –”

The terrifying sonic waves, mixed with the fluctuations of space and time, made all the beings within the world tremble from the depths of their souls.

“Hm?”

At the same time, the Child of the Void was covertly observing the beings within the world, especially the cultivators of the Martial Tao.

“Not bad.”

The Child of the Void gave a slight nod, expressing approval.

He had already learned from the Tianzhi True Lord about the threat and potential of the Martial Tao Cultivation System.

Yet, upon personally seeing the cultivators of Martial Tao and observing the Martial Tao they practiced, the Child of the Void was still somewhat surprised.

Evil Gods could grow to a height where they destroy heavens and earth because of their intrinsic foundation and heritage.

But what of the myriad beings, the insects of the world? They are but food for the Evil Gods, or perhaps not even worthy to be called food.

Consequently, the Martial Tao Cultivation System allowed these insects the possibility of growing into threats to the Evil Gods.

This cultivation system, distinct from the growth path of Evil Gods, surprised the Child of the Void.

“What a pity…”

“The conclusion is already determined.”

The Child of the Void shook his head slightly; as long as he controlled the Void Secret Realm, these cultivators of Martial Tao could not make significant waves.

“The great Child of the Void, that Taiyin Sovereign has not shown himself,” reported Lord Divine Eye as he returned and respectfully addressed the Child of the Void.

“Forget it, just destroy this world directly.”

The Child of the Void spoke, having observed for a brief time; his power had recovered a large part, already capable of mobilizing the full power of the Void Secret Realm. There was no need to waste more time here.

“Okay.”

Lord Divine Eye approached the world once again, spreading with Martial Tao, and opened his large mouth. Space and time began to distort, intending to swallow the world whole.

Seventh Stage and Eighth Stage Evil Gods needed time to devour a world bite by bite, but for a Ninth Stage Perfect Demon True Lord like Lord Divine Eye, it only took one mouthful to engulf the world before him.

Rumble rumble.

The world began to tremble.

The beings within the world watched as a gaping maw appeared outside their world, biting down towards the entire world.

Suddenly.

At that moment.

Lord Divine Eye’s expression changed, and instantly he ceased the swallowing motion, allowing the about-to-be-devoured world to slowly shift back to its place.

“There?”

Lord Divine Eye gazed intently in a certain direction, precisely the one that Tianzhi True Lord had pointed out earlier, the Tianqing World where the Martial Ancestor was stationed.

At this moment, within the sight of Lord Divine Eye’s perception, ripples of space and time continuously spread from that direction, swiftly covering a large part of the Boundless Void.

Not just Lord Divine Eye, all of the other Perfect Demon True Lords were also simultaneously focusing on the source of the spatiotemporal fluctuations, their expressions extremely solemn. Such a change affecting the entire Boundless Void was almost unprecedented for most of them.

“Child of the Void?”

The Tianzhi True Lord was the same, but he was the first to react, turning his head towards the Child of the Void standing by his side.

However, the Child of the Void was no longer standing in his original place.

Tianzhi True Lord looked around and found that, at some unknown point, the Child of the Void had already positioned himself in front of all the Demon True Lords, gazing in the direction of the Tianqing World, seemingly peering at the presence of some existence.

The Child of the Void’s gaze was solemn like never before, as if facing a formidable enemy.

The heavens, the earth, and the spirits all honor the Martial Tao.

What a Martial Ancestor of Martial Tao!
